notes: The native engine's 'network' is two queues: the s2c queue (survival.h, player-level packets applied by surv_client_pump) and the tracker packets (clientworld.c, entity-level). This record maps each vanilla handler to whichever queue carries it. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): wire format and connection plumbing: native messages are structs by design (SPEC: messages are structs, not bytes); scoreboard, teams, chat and tab list are single-player dead. Formerly listed as missing: The client halves with no observable effect in a single-player tape (scoreboards, teams, tab list, sounds, paintings, other players) are all unmodelled, and the clientworld entity packets cover only the kinds the entity tracker emits.
